card.name: Hyphens inside chemical names
card.fires_on: The hyphen or "des" piece inside a chemical name, right before a methyl/ethyl-type part such as mercapto..., ethylhexyl, or methyl. Also a locant digit like the 2 in 2,4-D.

modes.label: Hyphen after locant
modes.description: A hyphen following a number in a chemical name, before an alkyl part.

modes.label: Des- in metabolite names
modes.description: The "des" piece after a hyphen in names of drug metabolites, before methyl or ethyl.

modes.label: Locant digit
modes.description: A leading digit in a herbicide name.
